packageRules.description: The KMP SDK is compiled against one exact Sentry Cocoa version, pinned in Xcode (not visible to Renovate).
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Incomplete on its own: bump the Sentry Cocoa SPM pin in `iosApp/alphagps.xcodeproj` + `Package.resolved` to the version this release was compiled against (see CLAUDE.md → "Bumping Sentry"), and update `sentryCocoa` in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`. Until then the iOS link fails with undefined symbols.
